why_trail.why: The four P1s share one missing executable seam: an install-bundled pure verifier can resolve canonical constellation-* siblings and turn the three role artifacts/timing claims into ordinary command checks.

The test surface now installs the five real skills, resolves canonical sibling paths, runs the shipped helper against actual work-area artifacts, and simulates Admiral next-launch refusal through malformed, duplicate-audit, and repair-drift states.
Explorer keeps human confirmation as a separate artifact conjunct while an ordinary command check now proves the exact run output through the canonical installed G1 verifier.

Existing command checks now enforce actual Commander evidence return and one repair-safe, uniquely audited Admiral transition before the launch named by NEXT_WAVE; real installed-layout tests prove canonical G1/G2 resolution.
The refreshed identity binds the executable verifier, existing installer wiring, three role contracts, and adversarial installed-run tests for independent G3 re-review.
